name: Quantum Buddy persistent state/geometry shadow holdout
purpose: Compare persistent person-state geometry against ordinary control under identical prompts, seeds, checkpoint, and evaluation code, with no claim of unique quantum advantage unless matched controls support it.

cohort.construction: SHA-256 of UTF-8 'qb-phase8-v1|person|<i>|channel|<k>' for i=0..31 and k=0..11; unsigned first 8 digest bytes divided by (2^64-1), mapped to [-0.65,0.65]. Four bounded nearby drifts per person modify all coordinates by +/-0.02 using SHA-256 of 'qb-phase8-v1|drift|<i>|<d>|<k>' mapped to [-0.02,0.02]; clip to [-1,1].
cohort.assignment: predefined index order; no dropped hard states, no after-the-fact replacements

prompts: A traveler enters a forest and discovers
Explain why we should compare experimental controls.
What are two ways a person might solve a difficult puzzle?
Describe a small companion exploring a strange world.
What is the difference between storing a memory and generating a sentence?
A scientist records observations and later checks
Continue this story in a clear and consistent way: The sky began to glow.

ordering_control.name: permuted_entangled
ordering_control.purpose: Dimension-order negative control using entangled output; same tensor magnitude and same attention code.

outcome_definitions.primary_identity: Top-1 nearest fingerprint retrieval across 32 people using same-person drifts as queries and untouched base states as references. Report both qstate packet fingerprints and first-token model logit-delta fingerprints independently; do not substitute packet accuracy for model accuracy.
outcome_definitions.primary_quality: Fixed-prompt paired comparison against the ordinary model of exact-token repetition fraction and independently labeled task accuracy when labels exist. A changed response is not necessarily higher quality.
outcome_definitions.secondary_responsiveness: Within-person and between-person cosine distance of first-token logit-delta fingerprints, and full-sequence changed fraction at fixed seeds.
outcome_definitions.secondary_systems: Latency p50/p95, invalid packets, schema failure, ETag stale-write rejections, per-arm overhead.
outcome_definitions.control_inference: Report all arms and permutation; descriptive pairwise uncertainty or bootstrap intervals, no entanglement advantage claim from response diversity alone.

gates.applicability: Product identity threshold applies to the proposed serving arm at both packet and model logit-fingerprint levels; off and historical replay are deliberate negative controls.
